info.title: JackAI Platform OS Hub API (public subset)
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1.0 description of the JackAI Platform OS Hub API operations these SDKs wrap (`api.jackaisaas.com`): liveness, waitlist-gated registration, sign-in, the current user, and reserve/finalize/fail usage metering. Only routes the Hub serves are listed.

servers.description: JackAI Platform OS Production Hub API

get.summary: Check that the Hub API process is up
Inspect current V1 user registration policy (waitlist vs open self-service)

post.summary: Record a prospective customer access request while V1 public signup is gated

202.description: Waitlist request recorded with an opaque WL- reference

post.summary: Authenticate user credentials and issue host-only session or step-up MFA challenge

get.summary: Retrieve current user profile, organizations, and active security posture

post.summary: Phase 1 of atomic 2-phase quota metering: reserve credits before task execution
Phase 2 of atomic 2-phase quota metering: commit actual consumed credits
Release the reserved quota of an execution that failed or was cancelled
